suites.title: desktop persistence, resource and export integration

startup and new-window files load once and retain edits made before preferences finish
isolated bridge rejects ungranted files and symlink escapes

file operations, search and hidden filtering reach real filesystem
preferences, sessions and recovery roundtrip persist to disk
native menu shortcuts replace default accelerators and reject invalid bindings
invalid settings types preserve original bytes and boot with defaults plus a warning
clipboard-style image input deduplicates and exports self-contained HTML, paginated PDF and PNG
real Pandoc detection, DOCX export/import, formatting and missing-tool error
Pandoc output families contain the document and available readers reimport them; archive images survive import
explicit URL download and native clipboard remain while retired service IPC is unavailable
legacy service settings are removed on startup and updates without touching local documents or assets

include and exclude globs filter tree and global search consistently

polling detects external atomic replacement and deletion without inotify

opening an export calls the OS opener only for an authorized document path
export eagerly loads an image below the initial viewport
inactive file watchers are released and active folders notice external new files

new appearance settings and file sort controls persist with type checks
global search supports Unicode whole words and cancels an expensive worker
image insertion honors document image roots and escapes spaces, parentheses and Chinese paths
bundled spelling works on a fresh profile with only local dictionary requests
all eleven original toolbar commands remain accessible; formatting and mode switching preserve source and undo
Insert menu toggles, navigates with keys, restores focus on Escape, and applies a selected format in place
sidebar tabs use arrow, Home and End navigation with one selected keyboard stop

800px and 150% UI zoom retain reachable commands, status and preference actions without outer document scrolling
light and dark chrome provide readable text contrast while preserving source and settings actions
launches real offline desktop with rendered Markdown, math, diagram, and isolated Node
untouched save preserves bytes and mtime; local edit and undo preserve source
continuous Chinese editing, cross-block selection, undo and source switch retain state
formatting toolbar, table edits, snippets, regex find, and persistent preferences work
visual table grid edits, pastes TSV, reorders cells, and cancels without changing source

read-only, math copy, theme import, sidebar persistence, and export presets have real effects
external edit conflict keeps unsaved text and disk contents
real UI exports self-contained Chinese HTML, PDF, and PNG with hydrated math and Mermaid
Pandoc DOCX contains a rasterized Mermaid diagram and can be imported back
complete offline acceptance sample renders native legacy diagrams and advanced math in the desktop CSP
one-megabyte document editing and switching produce measured performance evidence

process termination recovers the unsaved draft on restart without modifying the source file
file tree supports roving keyboard navigation, collapse, parent, filename search and rename
strict parsing, CJK emphasis, code defaults, outline numbering and saved CSS themes apply and persist

startup folder scanning keeps the welcome editor locked until the initial document is loaded
late clipboard images cannot edit an approved window and commit rejects any later unexpected edit
native close offers exactly Save / Don't Save / Cancel, saves current file, and Enter activates Save
untitled Save As cancellation and write errors keep text editable; a successful retry saves before closing
Don't Save discards document recovery drafts, preserves disk bytes, and does not resurrect changes on restart
Cancel, Escape and repeated close requests preserve edits, restore typing, and clean windows close without a prompt
multi-window Quit is atomic on Cancel; Save and Don't Save commit only after every window agrees
closing during an in-flight save preserves later edits until the user decides what to discard

shortcut validation rejects inherited object properties without changing preferences
file URL images render and local links open percent-named files through authorized access

case-only folder rename preserves content and refuses a different existing destination
